integrity: The general theorem is proved symbolically. Finite exhaustive computations are used only as consistency checks and do not certify the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative reduced nonfields only; nilpotent and infinite rings are not covered. The 2026 weak zero-divisor difference-graph paper was available only through abstract-level material in the inspection path and remains a residual bibliographic risk because it concerns a distinct graph.
title: Badawi annihilator graphs determine finite reduced nonfield rings
